Zoe: hey friends — small personal announcement: i got promoted to Senior SWE today and also said yes last night 38948d 60d. double celebration next Wednesday 12:30pm in the 4th-floor lounge. low-key potluck + cake. would love to see you there! registry: tinyurl.com/zoes-things
Ben: WHOA congrats x1000!! can bring dessert or help set up 🍰
Kaya: this is the best news!! engagement + promo 929 happy dance 🙌
Iris: congrats zoe!! potluck sounds perfect. vote below for food option: :sushi: sushi trays, :empanada: empanadas, :leafy_green: big salad (for our vegetarians). react to vote.
Zoe: love it. thinking sushi or empanadas so people can grab handhelds. cake for 25 ordered. open to contributions. time is 12:30-1:30, drop by anytime.
CalendarBot: Event created — "Zoe: Promotion + Engagement Potluck" on Aug 5 12:30, Guests: 22 (added by Zoe)
